owner: Existing LessonRuntime / StepController generation; bounded extension to existing teacher presentation orchestration
transitions: cross next uncompleted blocking cue; reserve cue before async work
pause confirmed; target mounted with same generation
same media lease and resume allowed; play succeeds
scope/generation invalid, stale callback or failed operation

completionReceiptProposal.idempotency: Existing attempts need reliable operation key/reconciliation contract for retry/unknown handling. No automatic resubmit after uncertain response.
completionReceiptProposal.qualification: Existing server.activityProgress for bound Activity based on persisted qualifying attempt. Do not use parent nodeCompleted as Activity completion; first question can complete before both questions complete the parent.
completionReceiptProposal.revisionGap: Source revision is not student progress revision; add explicit readback evidence/version semantics to existing projection contract.

runtimeVsAgent: Agent may propose explanation/presentation; it does not drive state transitions for grading/lesson progression. Runtime resolves allowed business action against domain authority.
mvpIsolation: Same controller/services in development fixture; simulated server result explicitly marked fixture. Server grader/RPC integration verified in isolated tests before claiming production durable completion.
